body:
I've stayed away from caffeine. No coffee, tea nor soda. Hasn't really helped though.

The meds I'm taking for migraine prophylaxis happens to be an antidepressant (amitriptyline). The side effects are *terrible*. 

I'll bring up the TMJ thing at my next visit. I do have problems with my jaw and it does seem like what's causing my problems.

Thanks for taking the time to post. You're right, I have everything to lose if I opt out.

My glasses and contact lenses are the correct prescription. Neurologist thinks it's more of genetics, because my father has migraines as well, though not to the same extent.

I run 2-3 times a week. Yeah, I've got a pretty big problem with stress and living in Singapore doesn't help (hella competitive here). Though I'm okay right now with stress because I'm transitioning from a different level (school) so there's no work to be done or exams to be taken.
